content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only retired Odisha Police personnel can apply for the SPO posts. To be eligible to appear in the selection test, a retired person must meet all the following conditions given in the notification. Selected candidates are required to execute an agreement for re-employment on contract basis for not more than one year.

rows.details: 65 years, as on the date of publication of the advertisement

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Salary
content_sections.text: The notification states that the remuneration will be fixed as per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No. 24533/F dated 22.09.2022. The exact monthly amount is not mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection test will be held at Reserve Police Ground, Raurkela on 23.10.2026 at 06:30 AM. As per the notification, the test includes verification of original documents, a medical test, a physical test and an interview. Candidates will be put through a medical test. A Medical Board will test their physical fitness, and the decision of the Board is final and binding. Persons with physical deformities will not be eligible for appointment. Only those found medically fit will be allowed to participate in further tests. Candidates should be physically fit and mentally alert. They should be physically capable of discharging field duty by putting in hard labour for at least 8 hours a day, during day or night. In the physical test, candidates have to cover a distance of 5 (five) kilometres on foot within one hour. Those who fail to cover this distance within the time will be disqualified. Candidates who qualify in both the medical test and the physical test will appear before the Selection Board for an interview. The Selection Board will test the suitability of the candidates for appointment as Special Police Officers. Re-employed persons will have to wear the uniform and the badge as prescribed by the D.G. & I.G. of Police, Odisha.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification describes an offline process. Candidates must submit a neatly typed application in the prescribed proforma, along with the required documents, so that it reaches the DIG's office by the last date. Visit the Odisha Police website, police.odisha.gov.in, to get the application form and instructions. Prepare a neatly typed application as per the proforma enclosed with the notification. Fill in all required columns of the application form correctly and completely. Enclose copies of all the required documents listed below. Submit the application to the Deputy Inspector General of Police, Western Range, Raurkela, Sector-5, Raurkela, so that it reaches the office on or before 15.10.2026 at 05:30 PM. Two recent passport size self-attested photographs. Self-attested copies of certificates in support of age and qualification. Self-attested copy of the discharge certificate. Two character certificates attested by two different Group-B Gazetted Officers. Any application submitted in an incomplete manner or after the due date will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Application Form Details
content_sections.text: The application form attached to the notification is titled "Application Form for Contractual Employment of Officers Retired in the Rank of Asst. Sub-Inspector / Sub-Inspector / Inspector of Police in Odisha Police as Special Police Officers (SPOs) in Odisha Police". It has two parts: Part (A), the application details, and Part (B), a declaration to participate in the physical test. At the end of Part (A), the candidate solemnly declares that the information furnished is true to the best of his knowledge and belief. If the information is found to be incorrect at any time, the candidate will be liable to be discharged from the contract without assigning any reason. The declaration requires the place, date and full signature of the applicant. In Part (B), the candidate declares that he is in good health and fully capable of participating in the physical test for contractual employment as a Special Police Officer. The declaration also states that the Authority will not be held responsible in the event of any accident or injury to the candidate during the physical test. It requires the candidate's name, relation, address details (At, P.O., P.S., Dist.), place, date and full signature.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Odisha Police to fill vacancies for Special Police Officer (SPO) posts in Raurkela, Odisha, through an offline application process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 75 vacancies have been announced for the Special Police Officer (SPO) post under Odisha Police Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and mail it to the designated address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form for the Odisha Police Special Police Officer post is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for the Special Police Officer position?
faq.answer: Retired Asst. Sub-Inspectors, Sub-Inspectors, or Inspectors of Police from Odisha Police who are permanent residents of Odisha and have unblemished records can apply.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be more than 65 years of age as on the date of publication of the advertisement to be eligible for selection.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send the filled application form?
faq.answer: You must submit the application to the Deputy Inspector General of Police, Western Range, Raurkela, Sector-5, Raurkela on or before the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by Odisha Police for the Special Police Officer posts.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the verification of original documents, a medical test, a physical test, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can check the official website police.odisha.gov.in or refer to the direct notification links provided in the important links section above.
